name: Raw Wildflower Honey
description: White Oak Pastures' beehives are nestled in both our organic garden and fruit and nut orchard. They also forage our 3,000 acre farm. Our bees roam among blackberries, muscadines, apples, peaches, pears, and nectarines, as well as the native flowering species found in our nearby pastures. Wildflower honey is a rich, sweet treat for us all and an ingredient in many of our favorite sauces. Available in 3 sizes.

description:

  • Perfect for paleo, gluten-free, dairy-free, and vegan diets.

Need some recipe ideas? Try these raw cacao pili nuts as a topping to a quick and healthy high-fat snack: ants-on-a-log.
